Iain, saw Windfall built out new GTM leadership this year and unveiled the AI Copilot for go-to-market teams.

A new GTM team plus a product push usually means more accounts in play than reps can cover before the motion ramps, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Windfall off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Windfall needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Windfall's reply rate likely compares to other data and GTM software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
